title: missing seq
expectation: a gap in the logical sequence must reject; a completed prefix must not be accepted
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_SEQUENCE: NativeHistoryError: Native cold projection has an incomplete or invalid event sequence

title: duplicate/out-of-order seq
expectation: non-strictly-increasing seqs must reject
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_SEQUENCE: NativeHistoryError: Native cold projection has an incomplete or invalid event sequence

title: duplicate/out-of-order seq
expectation: non-strictly-increasing seqs must reject
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_SEQUENCE: NativeHistoryError: Native cold projection has an incomplete or invalid event sequence

title: oversized page
expectation: read length is a maximum; a page exceeding it must be treated as an invalid backend, not silently consumed
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_SEQUENCE: NativeHistoryError: Native cold projection has an incomplete or invalid event sequence

refs.notes: page oversize is listed as invalid in 03 §5

title: malformed read result
expectation: a backend result without an events array must reject and release the handle
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_READ: NativeHistoryError: Native history read failed

title: bad header id
expectation: a stored header bound to another Session id must never be accepted as this managed Session
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

title: bad preset
expectation: a Session whose agentPreset differs from the managed binding must reject
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

refs.notes: requested preset shiyu-runtime-replyer-v1 vs stored some-other-preset

title: bad header version
expectation: a non-current stored header version must not be projected as current history
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

title: bad isSeeded type
expectation: isSeeded must be a boolean; a string must reject before projection
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

title: inherited -0
expectation: the frozen SDK brand rejects -0; a recovered inherited count of -0 must never be accepted
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

title: I10 fractional inherited
expectation: inheritedEventCount must be a branded safe integer within the log and exactly 0 for an unseeded Session
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

title: I11 negative inherited
expectation: inheritedEventCount must be a branded safe integer within the log and exactly 0 for an unseeded Session
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

title: I12 inherited beyond log
expectation: inheritedEventCount must be a branded safe integer within the log and exactly 0 for an unseeded Session
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

title: I13 unseeded nonzero inherited
expectation: inheritedEventCount must be a branded safe integer within the log and exactly 0 for an unseeded Session
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

title: seeded cut marker
expectation: a seeded header must identify its inherited cut with data.inherited===true session/end-seed (or inherited===eventCount)
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_HEADER: NativeHistoryError: Native history identity or inherited metadata does not match

title: unidentified inbox message
expectation: an inbox entry without a complete native message id must reject rather than project an anonymous pending input
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_PROJECTION: NativeHistoryError: Native inbox projection or its sequence watermark is invalid

title: duplicate pending id
expectation: the official inbox fold rejects the same pending message id appearing twice; cold recovery must not accept it
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_PROJECTION: NativeHistoryError: Native inbox projection or its sequence watermark is invalid

title: invalid inbox splice
expectation: a persisted splice outside its lane range must reject instead of being clamped
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_PROJECTION: NativeHistoryError: Native inbox projection or its sequence watermark is invalid

title: projection failure
expectation: a projection failure must reject with no acceptance receipt and release the handle
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_PROJECTION: NativeHistoryError: Native inbox projection or its sequence watermark is invalid

title: missing inbox projection
expectation: an absent registered inbox projection must never be interpreted as an empty inbox
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_PROJECTION: NativeHistoryError: Native inbox projection or its sequence watermark is invalid

title: wrong asOfSeq
expectation: snapshot.asOfSeq must equal the last observed seq (eventCount-1); a projector claiming another cut must reject
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_PROJECTION: NativeHistoryError: Native inbox projection or its sequence watermark is invalid

title: read failure/no body leak
expectation: a read error rejects, stays diagnosable, releases the handle and never includes event/message bodies
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_READ: NativeHistoryError: Native history read failed

title: close failure
expectation: a close error must reject the operation (no acceptance receipt); the handle may remain for diagnosis, but no success result escapes
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_CLOSE: NativeHistoryError: Native history handle release failed

refs.notes: synthetic close failure is deliberately not marked closed

title: missing sessions service
expectation: flush, read-only persistence and cold projection are all required; a missing service rejects without opening/accepted receipt
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_SERVICES: NativeHistoryError: Native history services are unavailable

title: missing sessionPersistence service
expectation: flush, read-only persistence and cold projection are all required; a missing service rejects without opening/accepted receipt
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_SERVICES: NativeHistoryError: Native history services are unavailable

title: missing sessionProjections service
expectation: flush, read-only persistence and cold projection are all required; a missing service rejects without opening/accepted receipt
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_SERVICES: NativeHistoryError: Native history services are unavailable

title: Session not found
expectation: opening a non-existent Session rejects; no substitute Session is created
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_READ: NativeHistoryError: Native history read failed

title: wrong empty asOfSeq
expectation: for an empty log asOfSeq must be -1; a projector claiming 0 must reject
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_PROJECTION: NativeHistoryError: Native inbox projection or its sequence watermark is invalid
